description:
The candidate will develop solutions using SSIS, SSRS, SSAS and T-SQL in support of the Agencies business process and reporting requirements. Preferred candidate will be investigative/detective oriented, detail oriented, problem solving, and have an understanding of the power of data and criticality of its quality.
 

 • Develop ETL solutions using SQL Server Integration services (SSIS)
 • Develop reports using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) Develop cubes using SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS)
 • T-SQL coding, create database objects for both OLTP and OLAP databases
 • Performs impact analysis on change requests
 • Assists in documenting technical requirements
 • Participates in all phases of software development and maintenance lifecycle
 • Support defect analysis and resolution
 • Assist the ETL team in the design of efficient processes to load and manage the data, including a Data Quality Assessment to ensure the quality of the source data will meet the information requirements, developing Business Rules, Data Mappings, and Transformation Rules
 • Participate in and document data mapping session
 • Responsible for maintaining a formal description of the data and data structures
 • Assist the Lead Database Architect implementing data architecture principles to align and conform business capabilities
 • Assist in supporting multiple SQL Server data repository, which may include documenting database architecture and analyzing datasets to identify missing, incomplete, or invalid information
 

 


 • BS Degree CS or MIS or equivalent experience in related roles
 • 3 or more years or experience working with relational databases
 • Minimum 3 years of experience in SQL Server 2008/2012 T-SQL coding
 • 2 or more years of experience with SSIS
 • 2 or more years of experience with SSRS
 • Experience with SSAS and dimensional data models preferred
 • Working knowledge of Team Foundation Services 2012
 • Demonstrated ability to use discretion and make sound decisions
 • Ability to excel in a collaborative and distributed team environment
 • Ability to work with a minimal amount of direction while being pro-active in keeping their management informed of project related issues
 • Ability to work under pressure
 • Ability to respectfully question ideas and share a point of view with others in support of the business requirements and needs
 • Ability to effectively communicate with various levels of employees ranging from entry level to senior leadership
 • Ability to work on multiple projects at the same time and shift priorities quickly
 • Experience working on an Agile/Scrum team preferred
 • Proven strong problem-solving skills, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 • Strong aspiration to learn new technologies
 • Proven strong relationship-building and communication skills with team members and business users
 • Ability to maintain confidentiality
 • Experience in the education industry

 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". - All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply. - Candidates must clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment.
